approval.basis: 사용자가 말풍선 외피, 비율, 주문 묶음 간격과 DOM/CSS 연속 게이지 계약을 승인했다.

semanticPurpose: 손님 머리 위에서 미수령 주문·수량·완료 주문과 남은 서빙 대기 진행도를 표시하는 유동 웹 UI다.

sourceReferences.role: approved palette, warm pixel density, material, shoulder-width placement reference
approved head-status speech-bubble silhouette and scale reference

generation.promptSummary: Compact straight-on customer-head speech bubble skin; thin muted brass rim, deep indigo charcoal semi-transparent runtime surface, centered tail, open upper order space and one unsegmented lower gauge trough; no food, check, quantity, timer, cells, or scene.
postProcess: auto-key chroma removal with soft matte and despill

cssComposition.anchor: --customer-x and --customer-y place the panel from the tracked customer's head anchor
cssComposition.orderArea: upper ~60%; each unreceived food icon and xN quantity is DOM; completed item replaces its food icon with a circular check while retaining xN
cssComposition.gauge: one unsegmented horizontal track; --wait-progress controls .wait-gauge__fill width continuously from 100% to 0%
cssComposition.translucency: the isolated skin is composited at CSS opacity 0.91 so dynamic DOM content remains fully readable
cssComposition.temporaryReviewPictograms: CSS-only skewer and beer shapes demonstrate slots; they are not approved food icon assets

contains: the approved customer-screen R3 only as placement context
one R3 panel above the center customer's head
two unreceived DOM food examples with x1, one completed DOM circular-check example with x1

excludes: baked food icons, quantities, check state, time number, label, price, or seat number
wooden signboard frame, corner hardware, perspective, raised top face, or cast shadow
other customer, counter, food, table, shop background, watermark, or chroma-key color in the isolated asset
approvalQuestion: 손님 어깨폭과 머리 위 말풍선 배치, 반투명 인디고·얇은 황동 톤, 상단 주문/완료 정보와 하단 단일 연속 게이지의 비율, 그리고 DOM/CSS 유동 배치 계약을 검토한다. 음식 아이콘 자체의 최종 화풍 승인은 별도 단일 에셋 승인에서 다룬다.
